articles.summary: Early-stage founders move fast. That focus is their strength, but it can also create blind spots that lead to their company’s downfall. SimpleClosure CEO Dori Yona shares four often-overlooked founder mistakes that could put you out of business.
articles.title: Early-Stage Founder? Here Are Four Overlooked Founder Mistakes That Could Put You Out of Business

articles.title: Arjun Jain, Kunal Jain, and Lokesh Kamanboina are Building Tandem to Bring the Efficiency of AI to Hardware Engineering
